title: HALT-ALL marker
description: Single source of structural rules for the cross-repo HALT-ALL marker (~/.demerzel/HALT-ALL). Read by scripts/demerzel_halt.py (Python adapter) and scripts/DomainGate.psm1 (PowerShell adapter via Test-Json -Schema). See docs/adr/0003. Halt is ACTIVE iff this marker exists and has not expired — there is no 'active' field.

halted_at.description: RFC3339 UTC timestamp the halt was written

expires_at.description: RFC3339 UTC timestamp after which the halt is no longer active, or null for indefinite
